regimes.restricted_daily_product_closed: Isolated daily evaluators; period aggregator receives only scalar bounds, point loss sums and counts. No cross-day raw forecasts. Historical restricted reference only.
regimes.saved_forecast_archive_closed: Every saved TEST forecast row for the same meter, all four candidate columns. Every documented t+24 daily-persistence copy is incorporated, including within the evaluated period. Exact aggregate deductions follow. No outside-period forecasts, arrival assumption, nonlinear inversion, feature cache or raw-target fallback.

forecast_archive.row_index: zero-based data row excluding CSV header

retained_measurements: Original full target snapshot supplies nominal disjoint6/24hour totals BEFORE original artificial masks; each case supplies only its declared block size and symmetric0/1/5percent band. This is not measured backup-channel survival.

implementation_correction.high_demand_rank_source: Pinned original hourly source series; original stable argsort. Default CSV parse altered4near-tie masks in the failed first implementation. All34meters rerun; no tolerance relaxation.

denominators.complete_case: pooled observed-coordinate paired-loss numerator divided by total closed observed count
denominators.legacy_complete_case: equal-day mean of observed-only contrasts, retained only to diagnose compatibility changes

trace_encoding.masks: 24-bit nonnegative integers; bit h is target hour h
trace_encoding.value_hashes: SHA256 of little-endian float64 array bytes; observed vectors retain NaN at missing coordinates
trace_encoding.states: Deduplicated by exact visible-value hash and block/tolerance; fully observed state has block0,tau-1, empty residual arrays, and is universal for that same visible vector. No hidden-truth substitution.
trace_encoding.blem_values: Observation and residual/aggregate values omitted where they could reveal raw targets; row references/hashes support raw-dependent regeneration. Daily aggregate loss contributions are included.

recovery_attribution: Existing daily archive results only: budget2 PER DAY PER PAIR; no new period-wide paid-query optimization. Free reconstruction and exact-minus-greedy gain must be reported separately.
